scenes.name: WAITING
lines: An early quantum link must wait for its neighbor. Waiting damages stored information.
先准备好的量子链路必须等待邻居，等待会损耗存储的信息。
Neighbors ready at one and two merge at time two. They pay one and become a single link ready at two.
相邻两段在一和二时准备好，就在二时合并，成本为一，新段的准备时刻为二。
With fixed readiness and deterministic instantaneous swaps, the earliest neighboring pair minimizes total cost. Why?
固定准备时刻、确定且瞬时交换时，总选最早的相邻一对会使总成本最小。为什么？

scenes.name: FOUR LINKS
lines: Take one, two, four, three. The neighboring pairs can merge at times two, four, and four.
看一、二、四、三；相邻对最早在二、四、四时合并。
The earliest order pays one, one, two: total four. Either tied earliest choice is allowed.
最早顺序付一、一、二，总计四。并列时的两种最早选择都允许。
Merging the middle pair first can cost two, one, three: total six. Why the extra two?
先合并中间一对可付二、一、三，总计六。多出来的二从何而来？

scenes.name: THE POTENTIAL
lines: Define the potential: largest readiness time, plus neighboring maxima, minus the sum of times.
定义势函数：最大准备时刻，加上相邻对最大值之和，再减去准备时刻之和。
Here it is four plus ten minus ten: four. Along the earliest order, paid cost plus potential stays four.
本例为四加十减十，等于四。沿最早顺序，已付加势函数始终为四。
The final potential is zero. The worse first move pays two but leaves potential four, so the ledger jumps to six.
最终势函数为零。较差的第一步付二，却留下势函数四，使总账跳到六。

scenes.name: LOCAL EXCESS
lines: Merging a pair into its maximum affects only the immediately neighboring maxima.
一对合并为其最大值，只会影响紧邻它的左右最大值。
The left increase is the new maximum minus the old one: nonnegative, because the merged time never decreases.
左侧增加量为新的相邻最大值减去旧值。合并时刻不会变小，故增加量非负。
An earliest merge is no later than that old neighboring maximum, so the increase is zero. The right side works identically, including ties.
最早合并时刻不超过旧的相邻最大值，所以增加量为零。右侧同理，并列也成立。
Step cost plus new potential equals old potential plus nonnegative slack. Earliest steps have zero slack.
本步成本加新势函数，等于旧势函数加非负松弛量。最早步的松弛量为零。

scenes.name: CANCELLATION
lines: Add the step identities. Intermediate potentials cancel. Total cost equals initial potential plus all slacks.
把逐步恒等式相加，中间势函数抵消。总成本等于初始势函数加全部松弛量。
Every order costs at least the potential. Earliest orders attain it. Optimality means every slack is zero.
每个顺序成本至少为势函数；最早顺序达到它。最优等价于所有松弛量为零。
Earliest is sufficient, not necessary. Merging the last pair first also allows a total cost of four.
最早是充分条件，却非必要。本例先合并最后一对，也能得到总成本四。

scenes.name: EACH REALIZATION
lines: Random readiness times can be correlated. Fix one realization: earliest still beats or ties every complete competing history.
随机准备时刻可以相关。固定一次实现，最早成本仍不大于每个完整竞争历史。
For nonnegative alpha, smaller cost means greater exponential retention. Compare each realization, then average. Independence is unnecessary.
阿尔法非负时，成本越小，指数保留因子越大。逐实现比较后求平均，无需独立性。
This fixes the readiness vector and swap model. Other distribution schemes or key rates need further analysis.
这里固定准备向量和交换模型；其他分发方案或密钥率需要另行分析。

scenes.name: SOURCES AND SCOPE
lines: For natural-number times, the public Lean theorem checks every complete earliest history against the Bellman optimum, allowing all ties.
对自然数时刻，公开 Lean 定理核验每个完整最早历史达到贝尔曼最优值，允许所有并列。
Real times, exact slack and probability have written proofs by Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang.
实数时刻、精确松弛量与概率结论由 Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 给出书面证明。
Kamin and coauthors asked the question in twenty twenty-three. The mechanism: earliest merges create no excess, so nothing is wasted.
Kamin 等人在二〇二三年提出问题。机制是：最早合并不产生额外成本，所以没有浪费。
